drafted_from: tool:grade-a-video's own row in tools/media-composition/tool-rows.json, tools/media-composition/do-work/grade-a-video.mjs, tools/media-composition/read-data/looks.json, tools/media-composition/test/grade-files-from-the-account.test.mjs, and the script run on a synthetic 7 second clip
start_here: Say to your AI: "Give my video a golden hour look with film grain, a little warmer and a touch brighter." It runs tool:grade-a-video and saves the graded video in your files.
no_lists_because: It makes a new video in your files from the video you name and keeps no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Find your video's identity in your files: 1f: then 64 hex.

2. Say "Grade this video" with any of: looks (named looks applied in order, such as golden-hour, vhs, film-grain, soft-glow), brightness (-0.5 to 0.5), contrast (0.5 to 1.5), saturation (0 to 2), exposure (-2 to 2), warmth (-1 to 1), vibrance (-1 to 1), or match_to and match_at to match another video's colour first.

3. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run and tool tool:grade-a-video. The door runs it in a container and answers {"result": {...}}; an error comes back as {"error": "what to change"}.

4. Read result.looks (the looks actually applied) and files.video, the graded video in your files at its own size and length. A look that needs a grade file the account has not supplied (such as teal-and-orange) stops with a message saying so; the other looks still render.

worked_examples.title: Golden hour with grain, a little warmer
worked_examples.ask: Give my video a golden hour look with grain, slightly warmer and brighter.
worked_examples.given: read from tools/media-composition/do-work/grade-a-video.mjs and run on a 7 second 320x180 clip; both looks are filters that need no grade file, and the picture keeps its size and length

worked_examples.title: A look whose grade file is not supplied
worked_examples.ask: Give my video the teal and orange look.
worked_examples.given: From tools/media-composition/test/grade-files-from-the-account.test.mjs: on a computer where tools/media-composition/read-data/luts is absent, the teal-and-orange look stops with words, no stack trace
worked_examples.hands_back: {"error":"grade-teal-and-orange needs read-data/luts/06-color-wheels-teal-orange.cube, which the account supplies; it is not in this repository"}
